hero.eyebrow: Audit workflow, organized from preparation to completion
hero.heading: An audit should not begin with a scramble.
hero.subtitle: FinAuditEase helps accounting teams prepare throughout the year and gives auditors and accounting teams one organized place to manage requests, documents, reviews and the complete audit history.

slider.slide1Desc: Organize weekly checkpoints, month-end closing, and pre-audit preparation all year round.
slider.slide2Desc: Every audit request has an assigned owner, clear deadline, category, and real-time status progression.
slider.slide3Title: Keep documents connected to the work.
slider.slide3Desc: Accounting teams upload spreadsheets, invoices, and bank statements directly against the specific request.
slider.slide4Desc: Auditors inspect evidence, approve clean submissions, or reject with clear, actionable reasons.
slider.slide5Title: Keep the history after the audit ends.
slider.slide5Desc: Every engagement, decision, note, and timestamp remains permanently accessible for multi-year reference.

howItWorks.heading: Then the audit begins.
howItWorks.lead: And now, instead of starting from scratch, everyone knows where the work belongs.
howItWorks.subtitle: The audit workflow moves with clarity — connecting engagements, requests, assignments, documents, reviews, decisions, and completion in one unbroken chain.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Auditor creates the engagement, defining scope, timeline, and participants.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Auditor issues structured document requests with priorities and due dates.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Requests are assigned directly to designated accounting team members.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Accounting team uploads evidentiary schedules directly against each specific request.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Auditor inspects submitted evidence within the dedicated review workspace.
howItWorks.step6Desc: Auditor approves evidence or rejects it with an explicit written reason.
howItWorks.step7Desc: Engagement satisfies all statutory milestones and locks into permanent audit history.

capabilities.heading: Built for every stage of the journey.
capabilities.subtitle: FinAuditEase brings every part of the audit process together into five connected areas, replacing scattered spreadsheets and endless email chains.
capabilities.organizeItem3: Deadlines and assigned accounting team members

storyProblem.heading: The audit does not start when the auditor arrives.
storyProblem.subtitle: Good audit preparation happens before the audit begins. Accounting teams are already managing month-end checklists, reconciliations, records, statutory documents, supporting documents, and approvals. FinAuditEase brings that preparation into a structured workflow.
storyProblem.step1Desc: Systematic transactional posting, account reconciliations, and routine closing tasks.
storyProblem.step2Desc: Assembling statutory records, tax computations, and verified supporting schedules.
storyProblem.step3Desc: Proactive pre-audit checklists initiated six months before fiscal year-end.
storyProblem.step4Desc: Entering the formal audit with complete, verified documentation organized in one place.
storyProblem.bridgeText: Bridging the gap between corporate accounting and external audit fieldwork.

solution.heading: One organized platform from preparation to sign-off.
solution.subtitle: Explore how auditors and accounting teams collaborate across each stage of the audit lifecycle.

preparation.heading: Stay prepared before the request arrives.
preparation.subtitle: FinAuditEase helps accounting teams work throughout the year instead of waiting until the audit becomes urgent.
preparation.monthEndDesc: Keep monthly accounts closed and verified on schedule.

sixMonth.heading: Six months before year-end: A structured runway.
sixMonth.subtitle: Pre-audit preparation begins six months before year-end, giving accounting teams time to assemble records, resolve discrepancies, and forward prepared documents.

engagement.heading: Then the audit begins — with everything in its place.
engagement.subtitle: An auditor can create an engagement and organize accounting team members, requests, deadlines, responsibilities, documents, and progress.

request.heading: Every request has a clear next step.
request.subtitle: Each audit inquiry contains a clear title, description, assigned accounting team member, deadline, priority level, category, and reference attachments.

document.heading: Documents move with the request — not through a maze of emails.
document.subtitle: Accounting team members can upload the requested documents against the relevant request.
document.vaultNote: Client-side validation up to 25MB per document

review.heading: When something needs attention, the reason is clear.
review.subtitle: An auditor can review submitted documents and approve the evidence, reject it with a reason, leave appropriate private notes where supported, and keep the review history. Rejected documents return to the appropriate pending workflow.
review.actionApproveDesc: Evidence verified against financial ledger. Marked approved.
review.actionRejectDesc: Document returned to accounting team with specific audit notes.

auditTrail.heading: And when the audit is finished, the story should not disappear.
auditTrail.subtitle: Authorized users retain access to historical engagement information, including requests, documents, decisions, actions, dates, and responsible users.

multilingual.heading: Work in the language that works for you.
multilingual.subtitle: FinAuditEase supports English, Èdè Yorùbá, Asụsụ Igbo, Harshen Hausa, and Nigerian Pidgin across all screens.
multilingual.selectPrompt: Select a language to experience the interface in your preferred language:

security.heading: Security built on clarity and control.
security.subtitle: Architectural security controls built strictly from the product foundation.
security.item1Desc: Second-factor verification for all auditor and accounting team access.
security.item2Desc: Strict authorization boundaries ensuring members only access their assigned engagements.
security.item3Desc: Evidentiary workpapers and schedules are isolated by engagement boundary.
security.item4Desc: Secure transport and encrypted handling for all uploaded schedules.
security.item5Desc: Encrypted HTTPS transport and sanitized API error boundaries across all endpoints.
security.item6Desc: Logged actions and review decisions retained for historical review.

roles.heading: Clear roles for every participant
roles.subtitle: FinAuditEase separates responsibilities cleanly between external auditors and client accounting teams.
roles.auditorDesc: Creates engagements, requests documents, reviews submissions and manages the audit workflow.
roles.accountingDesc: Prepares records, responds to requests, uploads documents and tracks preparation.
roles.oversightDesc: Monitors engagement progress, tracks review milestones, and ensures statutory compliance.

finalCta.heading: Stay ready. Work clearly. Audit confidently.
finalCta.subtitle: FinAuditEase gives auditors and accounting teams one organized place to manage requests, documents, reviews and the complete audit history.

communication.consentDeclinedPolicyText: You have declined recording consent. Under FinAuditEase audit governance regulations, meetings requiring mandatory recording cannot proceed without unanimous participant consent.
communication.declinedPolicyRule1: The recorded session cannot start while consent remains declined.
communication.declinedPolicyRule2: Auditors cannot conduct walkthroughs without approved evidentiary documentation.
communication.declinedPolicyRule3: Please contact your Lead Auditor to reschedule or discuss alternative assurance procedures.
communication.providerAwaitingDeploymentTitle: Meeting Provider Infrastructure Awaiting Backend Deployment
communication.providerAwaitingDeploymentDesc: In-app video conferencing requires a certified backend provider integration (such as an enterprise WebRTC SFU or secure OAuth gateway). Unauthenticated third-party links are prohibited for confidential audit evidence.
communication.defaultProviderNotes: FinAuditEase strictly prohibits unauthenticated video endpoints or third-party meeting links that expose sensitive audit evidence in URL query parameters. Media streaming will engage automatically once backend gateway deployment is certified.
communication.recordingEvidenceDescription: Approved meeting recordings are permanent regulatory audit evidence retained under 7-year statutory financial reporting standards. Ordinary users and administrators cannot delete, truncate, or overwrite recordings.
communication.searchRecordingsPlaceholder: Search recordings by title, engagement, or checksum...
communication.noRecordingsDescription: No processed recordings have been delivered by the backend recording pipeline for this engagement. Verified recordings will appear here upon completion of server-side transcoding, SHA-256 evidence hashing, and access ledger registration.
communication.transcriptGenerating: Transcript processing is awaiting speech-to-text service provisioning.
communication.auditTrailIntegrationDesc: All communication, meeting scheduling, consent submissions, and recording access events are recorded in the immutable audit trail with actor IDs, cryptographic hashes, and timestamps.
communication.noAuditEventsDesc: No communication audit events have been logged for this engagement yet. Events will appear here as backend communication actions occur.
